scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @solace/shared && npm run dev -w @solace/api
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build -w @solace/shared && npm run start -w @solace/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build -w @solace/shared && npm run build -w @solace/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @solace/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @solace/shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
